description:
Use it when you already operate an HTTP API and want UnitySVC to handle svcpass authentication, routing, enrollment-specific configuration, and request metering at the edge. The gateway preserves the incoming method, path, query, headers, and body, injects the configured upstream credential, forwards the call to your `base_url`, and streams the upstream response back to the caller without storing the payload.

Use the free `byok` channel to relay every call to one endpoint stored in customer secrets (`HTTP_RELAY_BASE_URL`, optional `HTTP_RELAY_API_KEY`). Use the metered `plus` channel for many per-enrollment endpoints under one account; each enrollment binds its own `base_url` and optional API-key secret, is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` URL, and is billed at $1 per 10,000 requests. See “How to use this service” for setup and code examples.
name: http-relay

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own endpoint

summary: `http-relay` forwards authenticated UnitySVC gateway traffic to an HTTP endpoint you control.
